# Data Recovery Assessment

This public staging site provides factual initial assessment guidance for computer, drive, removable-storage, mobile-device, RAID/NAS and remote logical data loss.

Canonical pages:
- Chinese service: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/
- Deleted/formatted: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/deleted-formatted/
- Drive not detected/noise: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/drive-not-detected/
- USB/SD card: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/usb-sd-card/
- Mobile data: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/phone-data/
- RAID/NAS: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/raid-nas/
- Remote logical recovery boundary: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/remote-recovery/
- Repair/MSP partner referrals: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/partner-referral/
- English assessment: https://h20367825-spec.github.io/data-recovery-staging/en/

Confirmed contact information:
- China mainland hotline: 4008779100
- Email: 1175365450@qq.com
- The Chinese and English forms prepare a structured email with an inquiry reference and source fields.
- If a mail application does not open, the visitor can copy the complete inquiry and send it from any email service.

Important boundaries:
- Recovery results depend on the media condition and examination.
- Remote handling is limited to suitable logical cases with stable hardware.
- Unusual noise, impact, liquid damage or non-detection requires hardware-risk assessment.
- The service does not bypass passwords, account verification or device security.
- The static inquiry form stores no data on this site and does not claim delivery before the visitor sends the email.
- A generated inquiry is not evidence of a received inquiry. Only a received email, connected call or separately verified conversation is evidence of contact.
- Public accessibility does not represent search-engine indexing, advertising approval, certification, customer activity or a production launch in China.
